headerDisplay: Kia Connect (UVO) for Europe, powered by [bluelinky](https://github.com/Hacksore/bluelinky). Requires an active Kia Connect subscription. Your account PIN is needed for remote commands.

pin.title: Kia Connect PIN
pin.description: Numeric PIN from the Kia Connect app. Required to authorise remote commands.

pollIntervalMinutes.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often to refresh cached vehicle status. Keep this conservative — the EU API is rate limited (~200 calls/day).

showStatus.title: Show Vehicle Sensors
showStatus.description: Low fuel warning, engine/ignition state, and tire pressure. (Outside temperature and fuel percentage are not provided by the EU API.)

showBody.title: Show Body Sensors
showBody.description: Expose door, window, hood, and trunk sensors.

showBattery.title: Show Battery
showBattery.description: EV high-voltage battery charge and charging state where available, otherwise the 12V battery.

showMileage.title: Show Mileage
showMileage.description: Odometer (km). HomeKit has no mileage field, so it is shown as a light sensor reading (e.g. '12500'). Refreshed about once a day.

climateTemperature.title: Remote Climate Temperature (°C)
climateTemperature.description: Target temperature when starting climate control remotely.

vehicleIndex.title: Vehicle Index
vehicleIndex.description: If you have multiple vehicles, specify the index (0 = first vehicle)
